evidence.quote: Voldoe je niet aan de voorwaarden voor het wettelijk collegegeld dan betaal je het instellingscollegegeld.
Studiejaar 2026-2027 Start 1 september 2026 Wettelijk collegegeld Voltijd, duaal of master: € 2.694 Deeltijd: € 2.253 Instellingscollegegeld Voltijd en duaal: € 10.360 Deeltijd: € 9.976
Via Studielink kun je je aanmelden voor een opleiding bij Hogeschool Inholland.

notes: Tuition: the programme page does not state a tuition fee. The institution-wide fee page (collegegeld) shows for 2026-2027 an instellingscollegegeld of € 10,360 for full-time and dual bachelor programmes, which the page says applies to students who do not meet the statutory fee conditions (typically non-EU/EEA). The amount for 2027-2028 is € 10,665; we used the 2026-2027 amount. Teaching language: the programme page is in Dutch and the English-language counterpart page (https://www.inholland.nl/inhollandcom/degree-programmes/information-technology-eng-full-time/entry-requirements/) suggests an English-taught variant, but the Dutch page does not explicitly state the teaching language; the evidence provided is indirect and should be verified. Documents: the In- en uitschrijfregels list diploma and cijferlijst as documents to upload, with a sworn translation if needed, but this list is for all programmes; it may not be specific to this programme. Intakes: the In- en uitschrijfregels give an application deadline of 1 May 2025 for non-EU students with a foreign diploma, but no year was stated for the current cycle; this deadline is not included because the quote only gives 2025/2026 and the task requires a non-EU-specific quote with a year.
